name: The dwarven mountains, with harbour and life

request.action: A grand establishing landscape on a clear, bright morning, full of life: the sunward face of the dwarven mountains, the most beautifully made place in the world. Tiny dwarves tend the rooftop vegetable gardens and walk the stairways; smoke rises from chimneys; barges come and go at the harbour below, where dockworkers swing cargo. Homes and gate share one architecture: plain stone, clean horizontal lines, bold cantilevers.

Mid-morning at the dwarven river harbour, seen from a quay. Dwarf dockworkers in leather aprons swing a crate of polished steel armour onto a barge with a counterweighted crane, checking every knot; a human wine merchant haggles briskly with a dwarf clerk over a stack of barrels; the next barge waits its turn. Purposeful, orderly, busy.
